resource.title: [Jules Task 3] Strategy Matrix & Workload DNA Edge Cases
resource.prompt:
Add corner-case and boundary verification tests for Workload DNA & 5-Tier Strategy Matrix synthesis under scripts/lib/conflict/:
1. Test Workload DNA classification on high-density AI/VDI GPU configurations, DB OLTP high-IOPS storage configs, and edge compute nodes.
2. Verify that Ranks 1 through 5 are generated dynamically without duplicate ranks, collapsed tiers, or hallucinated SKU part numbers.
3. Stress-test fallback local RAG grounding (local_rag_search.js) to ensure proper secondary opinion responses when cloud NLM is unavailable.
Verify all tests pass with npm run test:all.

gitPatch.suggestedCommitMessage:
test: add tests for Workload DNA & Strategy Synthesizer

Add corner-case and boundary verification tests for Workload DNA & 5-Tier Strategy Matrix synthesis under scripts/lib/conflict/.

This includes:
- Testing Workload DNA classification on high-density AI/VDI GPU configurations, DB OLTP high-IOPS storage configs, and edge compute nodes.
- Verifying that Ranks 1 through 5 are generated dynamically without duplicate ranks, collapsed tiers, or hallucinated SKU part numbers.
- Stress-testing fallback local RAG grounding (local_rag_search.js) to ensure proper secondary opinion responses when cloud NLM is unavailable.
- Resolving an intermittent test assertion failure caused by an unhandled response scenario within the test_failure_modes_and_chaos.js suite when nlm binary does not exist but local RAG is executed.
- Ensuring tests pass with npm run test:all.
